init_client_manager: create a ClientManager instance to connect to a logging service server via Thrift RPC
put_metadata: use ClientManager to store a key-value metadata entry for a given partner ID
get_metadata: use ClientManager to retrieve a metadata value by partner ID and entity key
list_metadata: use ClientManager to list metadata key-value pairs within a key range and result limit
close_client: use ClientManager to close the Thrift RPC client connection to the logging service
